import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] p10 = new long[17];

    static String to_string(BigInteger x) {
        if (x.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return "0";
        String s = "";
        boolean neg = x.signum() < 0;
        if (neg) x = x.negate();
        while (x.compareTo(BigInteger.ZERO) > 0) {
            s += (char)('0' + x.mod(BigInteger.TEN).intValue());
            x = x.divide(BigInteger.TEN);
        }
        if (neg) s += '-';
        return new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
    }

    static void solve_subsets(List<Integer> v, int b, BigInteger[] res) {
        int n = v.size();
        List<Integer> left = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> right = new ArrayList<>();
        
        class FuncF {
            void apply(int i, int cur) {
                if (i == n/2) {
                    left.add((cur + b) % MOD);
                    return;
                }
                apply(i+1, cur);
                apply(i+1, (cur + v.get(i)) % MOD);
            }
        }
        FuncF f = new FuncF();
        f.apply(0, 0);
        
        class FuncG {
            void apply(int i, int cur) {
                if (i == n) {
                    right.add(cur);
                    return;
                }
                apply(i+1, cur);
                apply(i+1, (cur + v.get(i)) % MOD);
            }
        }
        FuncG g = new FuncG();
        g.apply(n/2, 0);
        
        Collections.sort(left);
        Collections.sort(right);
        
        long sumR = 0;
        for (int x : right) sumR = (sumR + x) % MOD;
        
        int j = right.size() - 1;
        for (int x : left) {
            while (j >= 0 && x + right.get(j) >= MOD) --j;
            res[0] = res[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf((long)x * right.size()))
                           .add(BigInteger.valueOf(sumR))
                           .subtract(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(right.size() - 1 - j) * MOD));
        }
    }

    static long count_with(String pre, long max_n, String nstr) {
        long val = 0;
        for (char c : pre.toCharArray()) val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        
        long cnt = 0;
        int plen = pre.length();
        int nlen = nstr.length();
        
        for (int len = plen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
            if (len < nlen) {
                cnt += p10[len - plen];
            } else {
                if (pre.compareTo(nstr) < 0) {
                    cnt += p10[len - plen];
                } else if (pre.equals(nstr)) {
                    cnt += max_n - val * p10[nlen - plen] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        
        String ns;
        if (n == 0) ns = "0";
        else {
            long t = n;
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            while (t > 0) {
                sb.append((char)('0' + (t % 10)));
                t /= 10;
            }
            ns = sb.reverse().toString();
        }
        
        p10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) p10[i] = p10[i-1] * 10;
        
        BigInteger[] total = new BigInteger[1];
        total[0] = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            for (int diff = 0; diff < Math.min(len, ns.length()); ++diff) {
                String cur = "";
                long val = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < diff; ++i) {
                    cur += ns.charAt(i);
                    val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(i) - '0');
                }
                
                for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d) {
                    if (diff == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                    if (diff < ns.length() && d == ns.charAt(diff) - '0') continue;
                    if (len == ns.length() && d > ns.charAt(diff) - '0') continue;
                    
                    String new_cur = cur + (char)('0' + d);
                    long new_val = val * 10 + d;
                    
                    long base = 0;
                    String tmp = "";
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < new_cur.length(); ++i) {
                        char start = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char c = start; c < new_cur.charAt(i); ++c) {
                            base += count_with(tmp + c, n, ns);
                        }
                        tmp += new_cur.charAt(i);
                    }
                    base += new_cur.length() - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> vars = new ArrayList<>();
                    tmp = new_cur;
                    for (int i = new_cur.length(); i < len; ++i) {
                        int cnt = (int)(count_with(tmp + '0', n, ns) % MOD);
                        vars.add(cnt);
                        tmp += '0';
                    }
                    
                    base += 1;
                    base -= new_val * p10[len - new_cur.length()];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        vars.set(vars.size() - 1 - i, 
                                 (vars.get(vars.size() - 1 - i) - (int)(p10[i] % MOD) + MOD) % MOD);
                    }
                    
                    int b = (int)(base % MOD);
                    if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        int v = vars.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
                        vars.set(i, v);
                    }
                    
                    solve_subsets(vars, b, total);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Handle exact prefixes
        String prefix = "";
        long val = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            prefix += ns.charAt(len-1);
            val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long cnt = 1;
            String tmp = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < prefix.length(); ++i) {
                char start = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char c = start; c < prefix.charAt(i); ++c) {
                    cnt += count_with(tmp + c, n, ns);
                }
                tmp += prefix.charAt(i);
            }
            cnt += prefix.length() - 1;
            cnt -= val;
            cnt %= MOD;
            if (cnt < 0) cnt += MOD;
            
            total[0] = total[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(cnt));
        }
        
        total[0] = total[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007L));
        pw.println(to_string(total[0]));
        pw.close();
    }
}
